title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Gender Equitable and Community Resilience programme using a nexus approach in Mambasa, Irumu and Djugu territories in Irumi Province, DRC implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to 4.1 The most vulnerable or marginalised in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. The activities and objective are safe and appropriate mechanisms that support the two-way flow of information, feedback, complaints; assistance is safe, inclusive and informed by ongoing monitoring of protection risks so Communities and people affected by crisis can hold Trócaire and local partners accountable against our commitments for an inclusive, dignified, and safe response Programmes are in partnership with Club des Volontaires pour l'Appui aux Peuples autochtones (CVAP), Programme Nourriture D'Abord (PNA) and Caritas Wamba.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 4.1The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs . SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this objective is:- Establish new systems & structures through which groups, communities or people can lead the response through an active and influential role in shaping decisions that affect their lives- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys
